subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change the default exported kind of legacy model-call spans from implicit `INTERNAL` to `CLIENT`, with documented dashboard/query migration expectations?
rationale: The patch matches the OpenTelemetry meaning of an outgoing synchronous provider call, but existing observability consumers can have filters or alerts keyed to the prior implicit `INTERNAL` value.

options.title: Document and accept CLIENT classification
options.body: Correct the public OpenTelemetry docs, retain the unconditional `CLIENT` behavior, and accept that operators filtering model spans by `INTERNAL` must update their queries.

options.title: Preserve the legacy classification
options.body: Revert the unconditional kind change if preserving existing dashboard and alert filters outweighs the semantic correction.

recommendation.title: Document and accept CLIENT classification
recommendation.body: Correct the public OpenTelemetry docs, retain the unconditional `CLIENT` behavior, and accept that operators filtering model spans by `INTERNAL` must update their queries.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head and assignment show direct ownership of the narrowed model-span direction.
